title: Condition-Variable Handoff
prompt: Implement a one-slot mailbox: `put` stores a value under the mutex and notifies; `take` waits (predicated) until a value is present, removes and returns it.

tests.name: take blocks until put
tests.hint: put: { std::lock_guard lk(m_); q_.push_back(v); } cv_.notify_one();  take: std::unique_lock lk(m_); cv_.wait(lk, [this]{ return !q_.empty(); }); int v = q_.front(); q_.pop_front(); return v;

tests.name: fifo across two puts
tests.hint: A waiting take re-checks the predicate after every wakeup — two puts mean two successful takes in order.
